sermon.title: Who is the Antichrist? 05/06/2018
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor David G. Kincer argues that the antichrist, 666 and false prophet are plural—people, not one coming individual. He reads 666 as the number of mankind, sees beast-like control of buying and selling in nations that restrict Christians, defines lying wonders as deceit and injustice, and walks through John’s five uses of antichrist. Paul did it all and was restored, so believers should reach such people with the word.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: Garbled words are marked [unclear]. Kept as spoken: Cornelius “denied Christ had come in the flesh,” called an antichrist (41:02); creation to Christ was 4,000 years. Unverified: Jerry Falwell said the antichrist was born in 1990 in Asia (4:15); legal limits on Christians in Egypt, India and China (2:49–4:15); 2013 science on DNA at conception (16:30); over 50% of Christians believe evolution (20:23). Sensitive content kept as spoken: addiction “not a disease”; pedophiles put “back in your neighborhood”; “Americans are so dumb” (13:09–15:14). California law would make his preaching illegal; homosexuals not born that way (15:14). Those who deny the unborn are human are “liars” (16:30). Illegal immigrants should be sent back; welfare recipients put to work (17:23–19:23). Schools teach homosexuality and bestiality (18:29). Big bang: “how dumb they are”. Jews, world religions, liberals and communists are antichrist; denying six-day creation or believing “only one person” in heaven makes you antichrist (26:52, 29:33–31:31). Catholics and Orthodox keep shadow laws (35:22).
